answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance rests on a refundable copper-weighted bond each new account locks before it can earn. Staking rewards are nectar that flows only after established peers attest to a steady history of honest work; a fresh identity starts as a cold ember carrying near-zero weight. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window for every fake, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays the bond just once.
